title: Distinct visitors per page
prompt: Return each page along with the number of distinct visitors who viewed it, as columns page and distinct_visitors.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE page_views8 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, page TEXT, visitor TEXT); INSERT INTO page_views8 VALUES (1,'/home','u1'),(2,'/home','u1'),(3,'/home','u2'),(4,'/pricing','u2'),(5,'/pricing','u3'),(6,'/pricing','u3'),(7,'/pricing','u3'),(8,'/about','u1'),(9,'/about','u4');
reference_sql: SELECT page, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor) AS distinct_visitors FROM page_views8 GROUP BY page;
